scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-media typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media/frontend-vue lint && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-locales.mts && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-renderer-range.mts && node packages/dms-media/scripts/check-docs-module-version.mts && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media exec antelopejs-check-interface-ranges
scripts.knip: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-media knip && pnpm --dir packages/dms-media knip
